canon.note: Castorice does not use the Energy system: her Ultimate gate is Newbud (an HP-loss pool, cap 34000) and the cast consumes no Energy. Basic 140701 Nethersea's Ripple = 70% Max HP Quantum at L10 (engine Basic Lv6 = 50%). Skill 140702 Wraithfly's Caress drains 30% of each ally's current HP, then Blast Quantum; with Netherwing on the field it becomes Boneclaw Doomdrake's Embrace (drain 40%, Joint Quantum ATK). Ultimate 140703 Doomshriek, Dawn's Chime summons the Netherwing memosprite (HP 340, SPD 165) and deploys the Lost Netherland Territory (all enemies DMG taken +20% at L10). Netherwing presses Breath Scorches the Shadow (each costs 25% of its Max HP), then pays out Wings Sweep the Ruins on disappear.

requirements.claim: Doomshriek, Dawn's Chime (140703) is Castorice's Ultimate action, gated by a full Newbud pool rather than Energy.
The Ultimate summons the Netherwing memosprite (SUMMON_CREATED owned by Castorice).
Skill 140702 Wraithfly's Caress is a Quantum Blast before Netherwing exists.
Netherwing presses Breath Scorches the Shadow as a Quantum AoE on its own turn.
When Netherwing disappears it pays out Wings Sweep the Ruins (memosprite talent 1140706), owned by Castorice.
Basic ATK 140701 Lament, Nethersea's Ripple is a single Quantum hit.
Lost Netherland Territory (140703) makes enemies take +20% DMG (ult L10) - the cast_terr debuff's resAll -0.2.
On summon, memosprite Talent Roar Rumbles the Realm grants all allies +10% DMG (cast_roar, dmgAll 0.10).
The Lost Netherland Territory lands as an enemy debuff (cast_terr).
Roar Rumbles the Realm applies to Castorice herself.
Talent 140704 Desolation Across Palms: ally HP loss stacks +DMG on Castorice (cast_dmg).
E6 Await for Years to Loom grants Castorice Quantum RES PEN +20% for the battle (cast_e6_respen).
Netherwing is summoned (Ultimate) before it presses Breath Scorches the Shadow.
The pre-summon Wraithfly's Caress Skill resolves before the first Breath (which requires the Ultimate summon first).
